style.name: Coastal Japandi
style.definition: Low, calm Japanese-influenced furniture with pale driftwood tones and soft sea-glass color.
style.materials: bleached oak; sea-glass linen; woven paper cord; chalk ceramic; cotton
style.living: sea-glass low sofa; pale oak paper-cord chair; oval bleached-oak coffee table; low bleached-oak TV cabinet; round pale-oak table with four paper-cord chairs; white paper lantern
style.bed: low pale-oak queen; ivory linen and sea-glass quilt; pale-oak nightstands and chalk ceramic lamps
style.solarium: pale teak outdoor seating with sea-glass performance cushions; round teak dining table
style.implement: Use pale green-blue in large textiles and keep artwork nearly monochrome.
style.avoid: Avoid nautical ropes, anchors or beach signs.
